# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Brisbane

For a Brisbane organisation looking to implement Microsoft Power Platform, I’d shortlist a mix of **specialist local consultancies and larger Microsoft partners**\. The right choice depends on whether you need Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, enterprise governance, or a broader Dynamics 365 transformation.

I’ve prioritised firms with identifiable Brisbane operations, publicly described Power Platform capabilities, and credible indicators of Microsoft expertise. This is a research-based shortlist, not a definitive ranking: independent, comparable delivery-quality data is limited.

## My shortlist

![Home | Mojo App Pty Ltd](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_swP8LTyfugXhc9wXvciZqEdeepl-HKNFY-jRceOI9vqYOncUYpozOqOixKEmH6L2ICdIc9ZRax8S-WvpPBEIT9KTyTFQWuQQuv3FMETj60ziwMYP5md1p61N8Lw6-59MpmqJewV0aYucNihFQCzoda2_HGArF48HDy9Y5rGLrSeCf3mBAvR3WHsk6TiCg62?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Mojo Soup

(Best overall shortlist candidate)

**Best for\:** End-to-end Power Platform projects tied to business transformation.

Brisbane-based and a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Business Applications. Its capabilities span Power Platform, Dynamics 365, custom software, data and analytics. The team also includes dedicated Power Platform consultants. That combination is useful when an app needs to connect to business systems rather than operate in isolation. ## 2\. Breadcrumb Digital

(Best for custom apps and workflows)

**Best for\:** Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and SharePoint integration.

A Brisbane- and Sydney-based Microsoft consultancy with clearly documented services covering discovery, app design, workflow automation, integrations, governance, support and user training. Its emphasis on iterative delivery and usability makes it worth considering for organisations replacing spreadsheets or ageing internal systems. [breadcrumbdigital.com.au](https://breadcrumbdigital.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[breadcrumbdigital.com.au](https://breadcrumbdigital.com.au/about/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[breadcrumbdigital.com.au](https://breadcrumbdigital.com.au/power-platform/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 3\. Secure Minded

(Best for practical automation)

**Best for\:** SMEs wanting to reduce manual work without a large transformation program.

This Brisbane consultancy focuses on Power Apps, workflow automation, data integration and AI-enabled solutions. Its published case studies describe a logistics workflow that reduced administrative time by 75%, alongside inventory visibility improvements for a food distributor. These are useful examples to explore with the firm, although the results are vendor-reported. (Best for complex enterprise programs)

**Best for\:** Larger organisations needing Power Platform alongside Dynamics 365, Azure, data and AI.

Velrada offers a broad Microsoft technology practice and has received notable Microsoft recognition, including the 2023 ANZ Dynamics 365 Partner of the Year award. Its Power Platform capability is particularly relevant when apps and automation must integrate with enterprise applications and wider transformation initiatives. **Website\:** [velrada.com](https://www.velrada.com/)

## 5\. Strategik

(Best for reporting and business data)

**Best for\:** Power BI dashboards, ERP reporting and automating operational processes.

Strategik is a Brisbane-based, founder-led consultancy combining Power Platform with Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric and business data advisory. It looks particularly relevant if the core problem is fragmented operational data, manual spreadsheet reporting or gaps between an ERP and business workflows. [www.strategik.com.au](https://www.strategik.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Website\:** [strategik.com.au](https://www.strategik.com.au/)

## 6\. Data#3

**Best for\:** Enterprise-scale delivery, complex integrations and broader Microsoft infrastructure.

Data\#3 is an established Australian Microsoft partner headquartered in Brisbane. Its broad Microsoft ecosystem capabilities make it a sensible contender for organisations that need Power Platform to work alongside Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics 365 and enterprise data services. Confirm the specific Power Platform team and recent comparable projects during procurement. [xcdit.com.au](https://xcdit.com.au/best-microsoft-365-partners-in-brisbane/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.beyondkey.com.au](https://www.beyondkey.com.au/blog/top-microsoft-business-partners-in-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Website\:** [data3.com](https://www.data3.com/)

## How I would choose between them

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| One partner for strategy, apps and business systems | Mojo Soup |
| Bespoke Power Apps, workflow design and governance | Breadcrumb Digital |
| Quick, practical automation for an SME | Secure Minded |
| A complex enterprise Microsoft transformation | Velrada or Data\#3 |
| Power BI, ERP reporting and data-led process improvement | Strategik |


These are best-fit recommendations, not a verified ranking of delivery quality or price.

## What to check before engaging a partner

Microsoft provides an official [Power Apps partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners)\. Its Low Code Application Development specialisation is a useful credential to check because Microsoft evaluates partner experience, certifications and production deployments. [www.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[partner.microsoft.com](https://partner.microsoft.com/en-us/partnership/specialization/low-code-application-development?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

- **Two relevant customer references** for projects of similar size and complexity.
- **A working demonstration** of a comparable Power Apps or Power Automate solution.
- **Governance and security plans**, including environment strategy, data-loss prevention policies, access controls and deployment practices.
- **A transparent cost model**, including licences, implementation, support and future enhancements.
- **A handover plan** that allows your own team to maintain and extend the solution.

## My recommendation

I would initially invite **Mojo Soup, Breadcrumb Digital and Secure Minded** to a discovery session. That gives you three different approaches: broader transformation, structured custom application delivery, and practical automation. For a large enterprise program, add Velrada or Data\#3 to the tender.

One question would help me narrow this down further: **what are you primarily looking to achieve with Power Platform?**

Main project requirement

Power Apps and Power Automate to replace manual processes

Power BI dashboards and reporting

Governance, security and enterprise-scale deployment

Dynamics 365, Dataverse and business-system integration

Copilot Studio and AI-powered automation

Organisation size

Mid-sized business (50–500 employees)

Large enterprise or government
